name: smoke-test-invite-seed
description: TEMPORARY standalone Admin SDK script. Creates exactly ONE throwaway, wholly-isolated staging team (smoke-test-team, under a fake league/season/division that exists nowhere else in chalkie-app-staging) and ONE pending Captain Invite on it, using the exact same field shape as functions/src/index.ts's performCreateTeamInvite. Never touches any real league/season/division/team/captain/VC data, never creates or modifies any Auth account, never deploys anything. See README.md before running anything.
